replacements.De los engranajes al ordenador universal: From gears to the universal computer
replacements.Tres siglos de intentos por mecanizar el: Three centuries of attempts to mechanize thought. Each era solves a different problem: first the machine, then the theory, and finally the union of both.
replacements.Máquinas que calculan, pero sin programa: Machines that calculate, but without a program
replacements.Qué puede computarse, y sus límites: What can be computed, and its limits
replacements.Pascal y Leibniz automatizan sumas y mul: Pascal and Leibniz automate addition and multiplication with gears. The machines calculate, but cannot make decisions or switch tasks.
replacements.Tarjetas perforadas controlan el patrón: Punched cards control the weaving pattern: mechanism and instructions are separated for the first time.
replacements.Hardware vs. instrucciones: la idea nace: Hardware vs. instructions: the idea begins here
replacements.Babbage diseña un ordenador general con: Babbage designs a general computer with arithmetic, memory, and branching. Lovelace writes the first published algorithm. It was never built, but the architecture was already complete on paper.
replacements.El razonamiento lógico se convierte en á: Logical reasoning becomes binary algebra: true/false, AND, OR, NOT. Decades later, Shannon will use this to design switching circuits.
replacements.Turing define qué significa computar con: Turing defines what it means to compute with a minimal abstract model. He also proves that some problems can never be solved by any machine.
replacements.Qué es computable, y qué no puede serlo: What is computable, and what can never be
replacements.La información es una magnitud medible:: Information becomes a measurable quantity: bits, compression, reliable transmission. Communication has mathematical laws.
replacements.Datos e instrucciones comparten la misma: Data and instructions share the same memory. Changing the program no longer requires rewiring the machine.
replacements.McCarthy, Minsky y Shannon apuestan: la: McCarthy, Minsky, and Shannon propose that intelligence can be described precisely enough for a machine to simulate it. A hypothesis, not a demonstration, but the field formally begins.
replacements.Inicio formal del campo de la inteligenc: Formal beginning of the artificial-intelligence field
